item: test_guard_sweep link-stats test removed the Source/Article/ArticleLink rows it left in the shared engine, which made test_discovery_isolation's bulk DELETE FROM articles fail on article_links (no ON DELETE CASCADE)
summary: Measured over a CI shard with a plugin logging articles + FK-child counts after each test: the one leaker of a non-cascading child table. Pair guard_sweep-then-discovery: 1 passed 3 errors before, 3 passed after. CI's alphabetical order runs discovery first, so it stayed green. Victim fixture deliberately unchanged.
